svg.title: Ripplefin Pools — Ripplefin rescue pools
svg.desc: Three nursery pools feed one sheltered channel. Caretaker baskets, low stepping shells and a plank nursery roof form an approachable escort route above the water. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.
svg.text: Shared access · None hostile; aid creature 1–5

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: Three nursery pools feed one sheltered channel. Caretaker baskets, low stepping shells and
a plank nursery roof form an approachable escort route above the water.
7 raised landings · 2 stairs · 3 ropes · 2 ladders · 24 props
R = same-map recovery · structural concept, not an exported collision mesh
Encounter: Ripplefin Sprout · Benevolent / Common; aid / escort / protection, never a kill-farm target.
